title: God
definition: God is the eternal, living, holy, sovereign Creator and Lord of all things. He is self-existent, infinite in perfection, and revealed in Scripture as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
summary: The doctrine of God is foundational to all biblical truth. Scripture does not begin by proving God, but by declaring Him as the Creator of heaven and earth. God is not one being among many; He is the Lord over all creation, the source of life, the judge of all the earth, and the One who reveals Himself to His people. To know God rightly is to worship Him reverently, trust Him fully, obey Him humbly, and receive His revelation through His Word.
christFocus: God is most fully and personally revealed through Jesus Christ. The Son makes the Father known, reveals God's glory, and brings sinners near to God through His finished work.

studySections.heading: God Reveals Himself
studySections.content: Scripture teaches that God makes Himself known through creation, His mighty works, His spoken Word, and supremely through His Son. Human beings do not discover God by their own wisdom apart from revelation; God graciously makes Himself known.

studySections.heading: God Is Living and Personal
studySections.content: The God of Scripture is not an impersonal force. He speaks, wills, loves, judges, commands, saves, and enters covenant relationship with His people.

studySections.heading: God Alone Is Worthy of Worship
studySections.content: Because God is Creator and Lord, worship belongs to Him alone. Idolatry is the exchange of God's glory for created things, while true worship responds to God as He has revealed Himself.
